title: VErsion Range Specifier (VERS) reserved types
description: The VERS types reserved by the VERS standard for special use. A reserved type shall never be registered as a VERS type. The 'invalid' type is always invalid; the 'example' and 'test' types are syntactically valid but define no version ordering.

reserved_type.title: Reserved VERS type
reserved_type.description: A VERS type value reserved by the VERS standard. The 'invalid' type is always invalid; the 'example' and 'test' types are syntactically valid but define no version ordering, so their constraints are taken in the order written.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of this reserved VERS type and of its intended use.

examples.title: VERS examples
examples.description: Examples of VERS notations using this reserved VERS type. Each is a well formed VERS that a tool shall reject because the type is reserved.

$schema.title: JSON schema
$schema.description: URL of the JSON schema for the VERS reserved types.

reserved_types.title: Reserved VERS types
reserved_types.description: The complete list of the VERS types reserved by the VERS standard, in alphabetical order.
